name: Shadow Serpent Trap (CR 5)
body:
Shadow Serpent Trap

CR 5

XP 1,600

Type magical; Perception DC 29; Disable Device DC 29

EFFECTS

Trigger proximity (alarm); Reset none

Effect spell effect (shadow conjuration, mimics summon monster III (fiendish constrictor snake), DC 14)

A quasi-real constrictor snake with glowing red eyes appears out of thin air and wraps itself around the victim’s neck, choking the life out of him or her.
